name: Honey
shortDescription: Kopano and Lereko enjoy honey-covered scones and ask where honey comes from.
longDescription: After eating scones covered with honey, Kopano and Lereko ask their mother where honey comes from, beginning a simple discovery about the food they are enjoying.
